861:t_037:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You're quite skilled, $$アルト$$. The skies are wonderful when I fly with you.」

861:t_037:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「When I fly alongside you, I also feel as though we become a pair of wings.」

861:t_037:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Oh...? Then does that make me your wings?」

861:t_037:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Hahahahaha! Think of it as my reply to your words, so full of romance.」

861:t_037:9.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I, too, am a romantic, being a Virgo... May I talk about it a little?」

861:t_038:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am a winged emissary from heaven... I've come to welcome a beautiful soul who has finished the game.」

861:t_038:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come, $$レア・イグラー$$... Let us spend sinful days together on $$アルテア$$...」

861:t_038:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Just so you know, I'm a man!」

861:t_038:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「For those who are beautiful, being male or female makes no difference. Come... forget the game, and share a night of depravity and pleasure...」

861:t_038:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Y-you over there...! Help me out and come back to the game right away! I'm begging you! Hurry!」

861:t_039:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「All right...! Here, I can practice singing without anyone interrupting!」

861:t_039:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Here goes, 'I Am $$ガムリン$$'! Listen to my soooong!!」

861:t_039:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Huh...? Are we already finished?」

861:t_039:7.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「What? You're saying you can't rest if you have to listen to my singing?」

861:t_039:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I see! I fire up your hearts that much!? Thank you, players! I look forward to the day we meet again!」

861:t_040:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I've confirmed the player's withdrawal. I will begin observing the player as a subject requiring caution.」

861:t_040:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「If the subject fails to return to the game within three hours, I will promptly detain them and...」

861:t_040:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Get a grip, $$ブレラ$$! Don't mistake who you're dealing with!」

861:t_040:7.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...Sorry. It seems I was having a bad dream.」

861:t_040:8.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Leave the rest to me, and relax to $$ランカ$$'s songs, everyone.」

861:t_041:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「We're ending the game! Let's do that thing before we go, $$ヴィラル$$!」

861:t_041:4.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You mean that thing...? That could be fun...!」

861:t_041:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Hope and despair, future and past! The two paths twist together in the final showdown!」

861:t_041:6.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We'll smash enemy machines with fists of steel! We'll seize victory with our own wisdom!」

861:t_041:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「The super robots face their final battle! '3rd Super Robot Wars Z Tengoku-hen'!」

861:t_041:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the hell do you think this game is!!」

861:t_041:9.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「They do this every time, so I won't even comment anymore...」

861:t_041:10.en:
$$ニア$$
「You've all worked hard too. Get plenty of rest, eat your fill, and please play again!」

861:t_042:3.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「You're already dooone!? We're just getting staaarted!!」

861:t_042:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「What's gotten into you, $$アーテンボロー$$? You seem oddly fired up...」

861:t_042:5.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Heh heh! I used to be held back by grown-up complications! Now I've got a face and a voice, I'm a hundred times more motivated!」

861:t_042:6.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「I could even replace $$ダヤッカ$$ as captain!」

861:t_042:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「Can you handle that, $$アーテンボロー$$?」

861:t_042:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「There you have it, $$アーテンボロー$$. Let's get some proper rest when it's time to rest.」

861:t_043:3.en:
$$リーロン$$
「$$ロージェノム$$, what do you think of this game?」

861:t_043:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Electronic games embody human desire. When that desire is satisfied, their existence is established as useful.」

861:t_043:5.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That is the natural order of this world... This work is no exception.」

861:t_043:6.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「So what does that mean...?」

861:t_043:7.en:
$$リーロン$$
「It means whoever enjoys it wins.」

861:t_043:8.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I hope we meet again.」

861:t_044:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're scrambling again today! We keep fighting for this planet's tomorrow!」

861:t_044:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But every enemy coming at us is tough! Seriously, seriously, at this rate the world will collapse!」

861:t_044:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Please, player! Lend us your strength! Let's win a future for Earth together!」

861:t_044:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z': 'Song of the Distant Galaxy'!」

861:t_044:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll do a $$イナズマキック$$ with you!」

861:t_045:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Hello, it's $$タカヤ$$! Guess what! I'm hosting solo this time! $$コーチ$$, Big Sis! $$ノリコ$$ is growing up another notch!」

861:t_045:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Ahem... Let's explain kill counts. First, when a pilot shoots down an enemy, their kill count increases.」

861:t_045:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The pilot with the most kills in the force is the Top Ace and gets a Will bonus when deploying!」

861:t_045:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The Top Ace is our force's brightest star! All right! I'll aim for the top with hard work and guts! I'm counting on your support, player!」

861:t_046:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Hello, it's $$タカヤ$$! Guess what! I'm hosting solo this time! $$コーチ$$, Big Sis! $$ノリコ$$ is growing up another notch!」

861:t_046:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Ahem... Let's explain kill counts. First, when a pilot shoots down an enemy, their kill count increases.」

861:t_046:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...you become the ace pilot everyone admires! Aces get bonuses to starting Will and funds earned, plus an Ace Bonus with a special effect!」

861:t_046:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Find out for yourself who has what bonus, player! ...Wait, what was my Ace Bonus again...?」

861:t_047:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's the '3rd Super Robot Wars Z' strategy lecture!」

861:t_047:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now, from one of the good kids playing Super Robot Wars, 'Super Robot Wars Fan' in $$愛知県$$...」

861:t_047:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「...we received a postcard asking, 'What are the $$Ｚチップ$$s introduced in this game?'」

861:t_047:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Oh! It's a postcard! These days, more submissions come by email, so I'm happy to see one!」

861:t_047:9.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Yes, they do. I was surprised too, since it's been so long.」

861:t_047:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I send my submissions on postcards whenever I can too! I think handwriting really conveys the hard work and guts you put into a letter!」

861:t_047:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And you can draw illustrations too!」

861:t_047:13.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ノリコ$$... It's almost time to go...」

861:t_047:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「What!? I still have so much I want to talk about!」

861:t_047:15.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We'll answer the question from 'Super Robot Wars Fan' another time.」

861:t_048:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's the '3rd Super Robot Wars Z' strategy lecture!」
